questions.question: What will be the difference in compound interest on a sum of Rs. 7,800 at 8% for 1 year, when the interest is paid yearly and half-yearly?
questions.solution:
Interest rate for 1 year when interest compounded yearly = 8%

Interest rate for 1 year when interest compounded half-yearly = 8/2 = 4%

Total interest rate for at the end of the year when interest compounded half-yearly

4 + 4 + (4 × 4)/100

⇒ 8 + 0.16

⇒ 8.16%

Hence, Difference of rate = 8.16 - 8 = 0.16%

Now, 0.16% of 7800

⇒ 7800 × 16/10000

⇒ 12.48

questions.question: The average of the marks of 30 boys is 88, and when the top two scores were excluded, the average marks reduced to 87.5 If the top two scores differ by 2, then the highest marks is:
questions.solution:
Average marks of 30 boys = 88

Sum of marks of 30 boys = 88 × 30 = 2640

Average marks of 28 boys = 87.5

Sum of marks of 28 boys = 87.5 × 28 = 2450

Sum of marks of 2 boys = 2640 - 2450 = 190

Let higher marks be x, then lower marks be x - 2

⇒ x + x - 2 = 190

⇒ 2x = 192<

questions.question: A metallic sphere of diameter 40 cm is melted into smaller spheres of radius 0.5 cm. How many such small spheres can be made?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Diameter of bigger sphere = 40 cm

Radius of smaller sphere = 0.5 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of sphere = (4/3) πr³

where r = radius of the sphere

**Calculation:**

Let the radius of the bigger and smaller sphere be R and r respectively.

The radius of bigger sphere R = 40/2

⇒ 20 cm

Radius of smaller sphere r = 0.5 cm

Let the number of the smaller sphere be x, then

According to the question,

x × (4/3) πr³ = (4/3) πR³

⇒ x × (4/3) × π × (0.5)³ = (4/3) π × (20)³

⇒ x = 8,000/0.125

⇒ x = 64,000

**∴ The total numbers of the smaller sphere are 64,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c945d5e86c6ae77403bdbeb329bd3104e3afec3e3d0b49520e8acdb2ceaf0ad.png] 

Number of smaller sphere = (radius of bigger sphere/radius of smaller sphere)³ = (20/0.5)³

= 40³

= 64,000

∴ The total numbers of the smaller sphere are 64,000.

questions.question: An article was sold at a gain of 18% If it had been sold for Rs. 49 more, then the gain would have been 25% The cost price of the article is:
questions.solution:
Let cost price of the article be Rs. x, then according to the question

125x/100 - 118x/100 = 49

⇒ (125x - 118x)/100 = 49

⇒ 7x = 4900

⇒ x = 700

Cost price of the article is Rs. 700

⇒ 7% = 49

⇒ 1% = 7

⇒ 100% = 700

questions.question: A circular disc of area 0.64 π m² roll down a length of 1.408 km. The number of revolutions it makes is: (take π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
As we know,

Area of circle = πr² and circumference of circle = 2 πr

Area of disc = 0.64 π m²

⇒ πr² = 0.64 π

⇒ r = √0.64

⇒ r = 0.8 m

Circumference of disc = 2 × 22/7 × 0.8 = 35.2/7 m

And, 1.408 km = 1408 m

Number of revolutions disc makes = 1408/(35.2/7) = (1408 × 7)/35.2 = 280

questions.question: If the area of an equilateral triangle is 36√3 cm², then the perimeter of the triangle is:
questions.solution:
As we know,

Area of equilateral triangle = √3/4 × a²

⇒ √3/4 × a² = 36√3

⇒ a² = 36 × 4

⇒ a = 6 × 2

⇒ a = 12

∴ Perimeter of the triangle = 3a = 3 × 12 = 36 cm

questions.question: ABC is an equilateral triangle. P, Q and R are the midpoints of sides AB, BC and CA, respectively. If the length of the side of the triangle ABC is 8 cm, then the area ΔPQR is:
questions.solution:
Side of triangle a = 8 cm

Area of triangle = √3/4 × a²

⇒ Area of triangle ABC = √3/4 × 8 × 8 = 16√3

As we know, If P,Q and R are the mid points of sides AB, BC and CA, then

Area of ΔPQR = 1/4 × Area of ABC

⇒ Area of ΔPQR = 1/4 × 16√3 = 4√3

questions.question: The population of a city increased by 30% in the first year and decreased by 15% in the next year. If the present population is 11,050 then population 2 years ago was:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The present population of the city = 11,050

Population increase in first-year = 30%

Population decrease in second-year = 15%

**Calculation:**

Let population of a city 2 years ago was x, then

A/Q,

x × ((100 + 30)/100) × ((100 - 15)/100) = 11050

⇒ x × ((130)/100) × (85/100) = 11050

⇒ x × (13/10) × (17/20) = 11050

⇒ x = 11050 × (10/13) × (20/17)

⇒ x = 10,000

**∴ The population of the city 2 years ago is 10,000**

questions.question: If the number 687x29 is divisible by 9, then the value of 2x is:
questions.solution:
Divisibility law of 9 ⇒ A number is divisible by 9 if sum of its digit is divisible by 9.

If the number 687x29 is divisible by 9, then

6 + 8 + 7 + x + 2 + 9

⇒ 32 + x

If we put x = 4, so that number become divided by 9.

32 + 4

⇒ 36

Now,

2x

⇒ 2 × 4

⇒ 8

questions.question: If a sum of Rs. 1,180 is to be divided among A, B and C, such that 2 times A’s share, 5 times B’s share and 7 times C’s share, are equal, then A’s share is:
questions.solution:
According to the question

2A = 5B = 7C

Let

2A = 5B = 7C = k

2A = k

⇒ A = k/2

5B = k

⇒ B = k/5

7C = k

⇒ C = k/7

Ratio of A, B and C = k/2 : k/5 : k/7 = 70/2 : 70/5 : 70/7 = 35 : 14 : 10

35 + 14 + 10 = 59 unit

59 unit = 1180

⇒ 1 unit = 20

∴ 35 unit = 35 × 20 = 700

**Short Trick:**

If 2A = 5B = 7C, then

Ratio of A : B : C = 1/2 : 1/5 : 1/7 = 35 : 14 : 10

35 + 14 + 10 = 59 unit

⇒ 59 unit = 1180

⇒ 1 unit = 20

∴ 35 unit = 35 × 20 = 700

questions.question:
The percentage growth of maize in the year 2019 over the year 2015 is:

(correct to two decimal places)
questions.solution:
Total production of maize in 2015 = 490

Total production of maize in 2019 = 840

∴ Required percentage = (840 - 490)/490 × 100 = 71.43%

questions.question: The highest percentage growth of sugarcane than previous year is recorded in the year.
questions.solution:
Production of sugarcane in 2015 = 1000

Production of sugarcane in 2016 = 1120

Growth percentage in 2016 compare to previous year = (1120 - 1000)/1000 × 100 = **12%**

Production of sugarcane in 2017 = 1250

Growth percentage in 2017 compare to previous year = (1250 - 1120)/1120 × 100 = **11.6%**

Production of sugarcane in 2018 = 1325

Growth percentage in 2018 compare to previous year = (1325 - 1250)/1250 × 100 = **6%**

Production of sugarcane in 2019 = 1250

Growth percentage in 2019 compare to previous year = (1450 - 1325)/1325 × 100 = **9.43%**

questions.question: The difference (in tonnes) between the average production of barley and average production of rice is:
questions.solution:
Total production of barley over five years = 975 + 825 + 700 + 625 + 775 = 3900

Average production of barley over five years = 3900/5 = 780

Total production of rice over five years = 415 + 520 + 585 + 625 + 600 = 2745

Average production of rice over five years = 2745/5 = 549

Required difference = 780 - 549 = 231
